scope: Paris campus information overlays, FR/light, from campus-details.css and campus-details.mjs

interactions.close: Native CLOSE action on close button and backdrop
interactions.trigger: Connected from conditional Paris details text button under the scope control on the four LTR homes; no city reticle on the world globe.
interactions.websiteLocaleCoverage: FR interaction only; web resolves Horizon locale, then English, then local language.

verification.tokens: Existing welcome colour variables, spacing/radii, existing 42/Floating effect, existing close icon/button and Action button instance; no existing library components modified.
verification.visual: Desktop and mobile exports examined. Button text aligned to source; clipping contains shadow within viewport; backdrop node opacity 0.12. Bodies fit with no clipped address or CTA.
verification.browser: Après rechargement du lecteur : France → Paris → Voir la carte → Fiche du campus → fermeture par croix. Bouton visible, fiche Paris examinée et fermeture confirmée par root ; aucun problème restant.

limitations: No campus-neighbourhood map existed in the Figma file.
The WebGL Paris view was inspected in Chrome, but Chrome content export was unavailable; no map image was imported and no geographic plan was invented.
These are composable information overlays over the prototype's current view, not a reproduction of the web's full map camera or 58 campus states.
The matching web implementation handles visible reticle/name information and offscreen-arrow recentering.
